title: Negative result: A4 four-role target diag([a],[b],[c],[d]) has exact minimum 8 (no seven-call word; radical-rank proof); no kappa
body:
## Statement

In the formal `F2[A4]` four-role model of #2116, the target `T = diag([a],[b],[c],[d])` has **exact minimum 8**. Here `a=(123)`, `b=(124)`, `c=(12)(34)` and `d=ab=(13)(24)`. There is no seven-call word, so the model gives no cross-role paid-call saving for this target. No `kappa` claim.

| Length | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| 1-5 | impossible | written proof (Lemmas 1-2); also both joins |
| 6 | impossible | exhaustive joins A and B (reproduces #2116); not covered by the written lemmas |
| 7 | impossible | written proof (Lemmas 1-2); also both exhaustive joins |
| 8 | realized | direct word, replayed exactly on all 48 basis inputs |

The kinds of evidence differ. Length 7 and lengths up to 5 are excluded by a written proof. Length 6 is excluded by a finite exhaustive certificate. Length 8 is an explicit construction. None of this is a multiplication theorem, a supplier result or a `kappa` change.

**Written proof.**
- Lemma 1 (C3 determinant): `det` over `F2[C3]` gives `n_a = n_b (mod 3)`.
- Lemma 2 (radical rank, new here):
  - Write `b = a^2 d`. Every word then factors as `W = A * prod(I + C_k^-1 (d+1) N_k C_k)`, with `A` in `GL4(F2[<a>])`.
  - `F2[<a>]` meets the radical `J` only in 0, so `A` is the unique lift `diag(a, a^2, 1, 1)`. The defect is `diag(1, d, c, d)`.
  - A twisted functional `Phi: J/J^2 -> F4` satisfies `Phi(r y s) = aug(r) Phi(y) psi(s)`. It turns the defect into a sum of `n_b` matrices of rank at most 1 that has rank 3. So `n_b >= 3`. Base `b` gives `n_a >= 3` in the same way.
- Together the two lemmas exclude `(2,5)` and `(5,2)` at length 7, and every length up to 5. Length 6 would need `(3,3)`.

The per-label floor `n_b >= rank_F4 Phi(L^-1 T - I)` holds in this `F2[A4]` alphabet for any number of roles. Whether it extends beyond `A4 = V x| C3` is open question 2; it is not claimed here.

## Milestone and decision informed

- Milestone: a local formal module. There is no supplier, no native conversion and no `kappa`.
- Question decided: the length-7 slice that #2116 names as its open question.
- Decision: the A4 four-role endpoint gives no formal saving, so this target gives no reason to price a native conversion of `F2[A4]` calls. The package extends the existing direct-optimal pattern of the formal finite-group family (Q8 #2047/#2248, SL2(F3) #2010) to one more target. It changes no current lead, supplier or selected result.

## Base and pins

- Base: `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`, under priority revision 6. Canonical main had not moved at submission.
- Pinned input: #2116's `RESULT.json` (git blob and sha256 in `SOURCES.json`).
- Package: `research/a4-seven-call-radical-rank/`, 7 new files. Nothing else is touched.

## Reproduce

```bash
python3 -I -B research/a4-seven-call-radical-rank/verify.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/a4-seven-call-radical-rank --check-only
```

The verifier uses only the standard library and compiles two C joins with `cc -O3`. It ends with `PASS_A4_FOUR_ROLE_EXACT_MINIMUM_EIGHT`, which reports:
- Direct word: 8 calls, 48/48 basis inputs.
- Lemma: defect rank 3 in both bases.
- Each join: 6,655,830 minimal-length-3 classes expanded and 1,597,399,200 children looked up, with no word of length up to 7.

The second command prints `PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS`. A run takes about 80-90 s wall time with about 369 MB peak RSS (Python 3.14.4, gcc 15.2.0). The generic runner also passed under a private Python 3.12.15 (`PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`).

## Certificates and negative controls

- **Two separately implemented exhaustive joins** (same AI-assisted session).
  - Join A uses 4x4 matrices of 12-bit masks, left-inverse enumeration and a GF(2)-linear incremental hash.
  - Join B uses graded 12 x 16-bit coefficient matrices, right-inverse enumeration, a left-multiplication `P<=3` build and a nonlinear hash.
  - Both find `P<=3` = 1/240/41,920/6,655,830 (total 6,697,991). This matches #2116's pinned `right_distinct_exact_states`, and the verifier asserts it.
- **Verifier checks of the proof.** Every proof step is checked numerically: the factor split for all 120 idempotents, `dim J = 9`, unique lifts, the twisted bimodule law on all 512 elements of `J`, `Phi(J^2) = 0`, the step-5 identity on random words, and the determinant formula on random words.
- **Negative and positive controls.**
  - Each of the 8 single-call omissions of the direct word is rejected.
  - The label mutation (final call `b -> a`) is rejected.
  - Three-output control `diag([a],[b],[c],1)`: the defect rank drops to 2, and both joins find `(3,3)` 6-words that Python replays exactly.
  - Planted 7-words (2 per join) are found and replayed.

## Scope, assumptions, unresolved obligations

- The model is inherited unchanged from #2116: 240 rank-one idempotent factors `D_N(g) = I + ([g]+[1])N` with `g` in `{a,b}`, unit prices, four roles, dirty inputs, no workspace and exact equality of every formal coefficient.
- Free scalar `GL4(F2)` mixing and role permutations do not help. Conjugating them to the left leaves a scalar factor that augmentation forces to be `I`.
- Length 6 is excluded only by exhaustive search. A written proof of it is open question 1.
- Unpriced (unknown, not zero): native conversion, restored workspace, a physical caller, chronology, hosting, precision, recursive transfer and supplier admission.

## Search record

- Domain: all words of length up to 7 over the 240-factor alphabet. They are organized as `X·Y` and `X·f·Y`, with `X` and `Y` in `P<=3`.
- Coverage is complete in each join. Hashing is deterministic.
- There is no C3 or coset pruning and no early exit. Sampling is used only in the controls.
- No timeouts and no memory limits were hit.

## Credit and concurrent work

- The model, alphabet, direct word, C3 screen and the original length-6 exclusion come from #2116 (`research/a4-commutator-four-role-seed-dcbf`, GitHub @1337isnot1337, commit author Cinna Davis, head `19cdf74a`). This PR answers that package's named open question.
- Prior untwisted `J/J^2` arguments, all by @1337isnot1337: Q8 in #2047 and #2248, and the abelian rational-frame floor in #2085. #2085 is the closest analogue of the rank-count step.
- Open #3893 (@1337isnot1337) is a concurrent, different rank floor for S3.
- To our knowledge (a search of `research/*/README.md` and open PRs at the base), three ingredients are new: the semisimple split in a non-local group algebra, the twisted functional, and the use of both bases together with the C3 determinant.

Claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2095#discussioncomment-19037476

## Review provenance

The package was reviewed by four independent AI review passes in the same loop: reproducibility, adversarial mathematics, provenance and referee. They raised only minor issues, all of which were addressed in one revision. The math pass also checked the result with its own construction of A4 and its own exact BFS for length up to 6. No human review is claimed.
